propositions: The DC harness errored all 62 cells at fixture setup because wait_for_jira_dc_ready checked for Epic Link/Epic Name fields at session start, before any Jira Software project existed to provision them.

GreenHopper provisions Epic Link and Epic Name fields only when the first Jira Software project is created, not at plugin startup, creating a circular dependency where the readiness gate blocked the very action that could satisfy it.

The original diagnosis incorrectly blamed an insufficiently short budget (600s/1800s); experiment 30981084637 proved the ordering deadlock by showing that 180 seconds of idle time changed nothing, but project creation succeeded in 0.0512 seconds.

The fix relocates the Epic field readiness check from session start to _assert_project_capabilities, which runs immediately after project creation, changing the budget from 600s to 120s and poll cadence from 10s to 1s since the provisioning latency is sub-second.

The misleading decision rule in not_ready_message ('absent customfield entries means the plugin is still starting') is corrected to reflect that an empty custom-field inventory is the normal state of a Jira instance with no project and cannot be used to diagnose the readiness condition.
Run 30982731669 verified the fix with 62 passed cells and 0 errored/failed, confirming Epic field registration occurs 0.032-0.058 seconds after project creation in all 57 observed cases.
